name: nobitex-smart-scanner
description: Nobitex multi-timeframe crypto market scanner wrapped with Capacitor for Android

scripts.check:node: node -e "const major=Number(process.versions.node.split('.')[0]); console.log('Node.js',process.version); if(major<22){console.error('Capacitor 8 requires Node.js >=22. Install Node.js 22 LTS and retry.'); process.exit(1)}"
scripts.cap:add:android: npm run check:node && npm run prepare:web && cap add android
scripts.cap:sync:android: npm run check:node && npm run prepare:web && cap sync android
scripts.android:debug: npm run check:node && npm run cap:sync:android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
